name: Pucón
tagline: Lakes, hot springs and an active volcano
summary: Pucón is Chile's adventure town on Lake Villarrica, under the smoking cone of Villarrica volcano. Climb the volcano when it is open, soak in the Termas Geométricas hot springs, hike among monkey-puzzle trees in Huerquehue National Park and raft the Trancura river.
seasonNote: December to March for hiking and lakes; winter brings skiing. Volcano climbs depend on activity level.
arrival: Flights to Temuco or Pucón airport; buses from Santiago take about 10 hours.
gettingAround: Tours and buses; a car helps.
cashTip: Cards work widely; carry pesos for buses and small shops. A 10 percent tip is suggested on the bill.
foodTip: Mapuche dishes, Chilean empanadas and kuchen cakes from German settlers.
